name: Jowhar

routes.outcome: Official Federal Ministry of Energy and Water Resources site was found. It is a general ministry portal; no Jowhar cadastral viewer, parcel schema, or public parcel endpoint was identified.
Official national-ministry document search result mentions a map of Hirshabelle State and Jowhar District, but it is general/report material and not a parcel service or local registry API.
TLS-verified public GET could not resolve the host in this environment (curl HTTP 000, DNS resolution failure). No retry with certificate bypass or credentials was attempted.
TLS-verified GET returned HTTP 200 and an official ministry HTML page. No viewer configuration, parcel service URL, schema, CRS, or native parcel identity was exposed by the page inspection.

Somali/English legal text describes ministry and district agricultural land registers generally. It does not evidence a public Jowhar registry or parcel geometry service, and no unsafe fields were requested.

TLS-verified official Federal Ministry of Planning project page returned HTTP 200 and listed Hirshabelle among administrations; it exposed no cadastral layer, parcel API, or local land-registry endpoint.
TLS-verified official Jowhar page returned HTTP 200 and describes electoral registration/GIS activity. This is not cadastral parcel evidence and no parcel service was exposed.
UNOSAT Jowhar flood/natural-landscape map provides contextual imagery and WGS 84 UTM Zone 38N metadata, not cadastral parcels or native parcel IDs; it was not retained as a parcel sample.

South West State urban-land law describes a state land registry and local-government land information, but it governs South West State rather than Jowhar/Hirshabelle. It was not treated as Jowhar registry evidence.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [2.77770492063847, 45.5019966407998] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or parcel-hit forcing was attempted.
DNS failure, general ministry pages, non-cadastral maps, and lack of an exposed parcel response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
National agency prose, general legal material, and a South West State law were distinguished from a local Jowhar/Hirshabelle registry custodian.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe anonymous native ID-plus-geometry response was available.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Request/page captures and scratch evidence belong under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/jowhar/.
uncertainty: Somalia has legal and administrative references to land registration, and official material references Jowhar/Hirshabelle mapping or GIS in non-cadastral contexts. Public coverage of Jowhar parcels, any local custodian's data, viewer/API availability, schema, CRS, native identity, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified. No citywide absence inference is made.
